name: RogueRealms [BETA]
desc:
🔥A co-op roguelike (1 to 4 players) where you face endless waves of enemies, growing stronger as you progress.🔥

🧬Over 70 classes, each with 3 unique mutations to unlock! 🧬

🔄 Lost connection ? Use the rejoin feature in the hub!




⚠️ The game is in BETA, expect many bugs and many features to come. Please report any bug that you find


❤️Inspired by RogueBlade, Randomly Generated Droids, Brotato, Gunfire Reborn, and Warframe

🎨Icon/Thumbnail by @TheMysticalSarene and @OutThereArtistOta
🎵Music (used in the trailer) by @madantes (Youtube)
